tocMobile_ITEo"><button type="button" class="clean-btn tocCollapsibleButton_TO0P">On this page</button></div><div class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><header><h1>DZBuild API</h1></header>
<p>The DZBuild API lets you manage your store programmatically: products, orders, customers, landing pages, plus a high-volume <strong>signup tracker</strong> for merchants embedding DZBuild in their own platforms.</p>
<p><strong>Base URL:</strong> <code>https://api.dzbuild.app/v1</code> (also reachable as <code>https://dzbuild.com/api/v1</code>, the same routes mirrored on the main hostname).
<strong>Versioning:</strong> stable <code>v1</code>. Breaking changes require a new path prefix.
<strong>Format:</strong> JSON in, JSON out, UTF-8.
<strong>Authentication:</strong> see <a class="" href="/api-docs/authentication">Authentication</a>.
<strong>Status:</strong> Pilot. To enroll, contact <code>support@dzbuild.com</code> with your store id — pilot keys are minted on request while we soak-test rate limits and abuse heuristics.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Note for super-admins:</strong> the API also exposes <code>/v1/admin/*</code> endpoints (key suspension, quota overrides, global usage). These are restricted to platform staff and are intentionally not part of the public reference.</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="architecture">Architecture<a href="#architecture" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Architecture" title="Direct link to Architecture" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p>Requests hit Cloudflare Workers at the edge in 300+ POPs:</p>
<ul>
<li class="">Auth + HMAC verification at edge — origin never sees an unauthenticated request.</li>
<li class="">Per-key sliding-window rate limit at edge.</li>
<li class="">Read-cache (30s TTL) for safe GETs.</li>
<li class="">Writes are forwarded to origin with edge-attestation headers; the origin double-checks.</li>
<li class="">High-volume writes (<code>/v1/signups</code>, <code>/v1/events</code>) go through Cloudflare Queues and return <code>202 Accepted</code> immediately — your call doesn't wait for the database.</li>
</ul></div></article><nav class="docusaurus-mt-lg pagination-nav" aria-label="Docs pages"><a class="pagination-nav__link pagination-nav__link--next" href="/api-docs/authentication"><div
